task_template: Open the very top drawer directly underneath the countertop on the {side} of the robot's starting position. This is the highest drawer in that stack, above every other drawer. Pulling out a lower drawer while the top drawer stays shut is failure. The target must finish open by roughly half its front-to-back depth. Holding the handle is allowed. The three synchronized views show the same scene. Use the clearest available view of the target; the drawer need not be visible in every view. Left/right refers to the robot at the start, not the current image edge.
native_instruction_rewrite: Deterministic side extraction only; explicit native target and terminal predicate
change: View evidence and robot-relative side clarification only; terminal predicate retained.
